# TED Üsküdar Koleji

> A comprehensive K-12 institution in Istanbul affiliated with Türk Eğitim Derneği, offering modern facilities, rigorous academics, and holistic student development.

TED Üsküdar Koleji is a prestigious private school in Istanbul, Turkey, part of the Turkish Education Association network. The school emphasizes academic excellence, modern educational technology, campus safety, and student wellness across all grade levels.

## Key Topics

- TED Üsküdar Koleji
- Türk Eğitim Derneği (Turkish Education Association)
- K-12 education
- Campus facilities
- Educational philosophy

## Institutional Overview

- [TED Üsküdar Koleji](https://www.teduskudar.k12.tr): TED Üsküdar Koleji homepage showcasing comprehensive K-12 education with modern campus.
- [TED Üsküdar Koleji | Kurumsal](https://www.teduskudar.k12.tr/kurumsal/ted-uskudar-koleji): TED Üsküdar Koleji institutional overview with campus facilities and academic programs.
- [Türk Eğitim Derneği](https://www.teduskudar.k12.tr/kurumsal/turk-egitim-dernegi): Turkish Education Association history and mission foundational to TED Üsküdar.
- [Misyon ve Vizyon](https://www.teduskudar.k12.tr/kurumsal/misyon-ve-vizyon): School mission, vision, and core educational values and philosophy.

## Leadership and Faculty

- [Genel Koordinatörümüz](https://www.teduskudar.k12.tr/kurumsal/yoneticilerimiz): General Coordinator Nevzat Kulaberoglu biography and leadership profile.
- [Akademik Kadro](https://www.teduskudar.k12.tr/kurumsal/akademik-kadro): Academic faculty and staff information with professional development details.

## Campus Facilities and Services

- [Spor Tesisleri](https://www.teduskudar.k12.tr/kampus/spor-tesisleri): Sports facilities including pools and indoor sports for student development.
- [Sağlık Hizmetleri](https://www.teduskudar.k12.tr/kampus/saglik-hizmetleri): Health services, medical screening, and student wellness programs.
- [Kütüphane](https://www.teduskudar.k12.tr/kampus/kutuphane): School library and information center supporting student learning resources.
- [Atölyeler](https://www.teduskudar.k12.tr/kampus/atolyeler): School workshops for arts, performance, and talent development activities.
- [Yemek Hizmetleri](https://www.teduskudar.k12.tr/kampus/yemek-hizmetleri): Dining facilities with nutritious meal planning and health safety standards.
- [Ulaşım Hizmetleri](https://www.teduskudar.k12.tr/kampus/ulasim-hizmetleri): School shuttle and transportation services ensuring student safety.
- [Güvenlik Hizmetleri](https://www.teduskudar.k12.tr/kampus/guvenlik-hizmetleri): Campus security with 24-hour monitoring and access control systems.
- [Eğitim Teknolojileri](https://www.teduskudar.k12.tr/kampus/egitim-teknolojileri): Educational technology labs supporting STEM and 21st-century digital skills.

## Safety and Infrastructure

- [Deprem ve Acil Durum Bilgilendirmesi](https://www.teduskudar.k12.tr/kampus/deprem-ve-acil-durum-bilgilendirmesi): Emergency procedures, earthquake safety protocols, and evacuation guidelines.
- [Fiziki Yapı ve Deprem Güvenliği Teknik Rapor](https://www.teduskudar.k12.tr/kampus/fiziki-yapi-ve-deprem-guvenligi-teknik-rapor): Technical report on building infrastructure and earthquake safety compliance.

## Enrollment and Financial Information

- [Kayıt Ücretleri](https://www.teduskudar.k12.tr/kayit/kayit-ucretleri): Enrollment fees, tuition costs, and payment information for registration.
- [İndirimler ve Burslar](https://www.teduskudar.k12.tr/kayit/indirimler-ve-burslar): Scholarships, tuition discounts, and financial aid for eligible students.
